stage 1 of the v5 build: gather every mined record across 13 roots, remove the 35% that are cross-root duplicates of the same task mined twice under a per-root resume contract, thin repair down from 9.24 answers per distinct problem, and cache typed records so no later stage re-scans 3.5GB

stage 2 of the v5 build: rewrite verified twins into the question shapes the arena asks and v4 never posed (torch2hip, torch2flydsl, triton2flydsl, instruction2*), by pairing each gate-passed kernel with the reference.py it was synthesised from; generates nothing and re-runs nothing, and reaches the twin registries directly rather than being capped at one row per winning task

stage 2b of the v5 build: a FlyDSL language anchor drawn from the DSL's own test suite and tutorials, since the base model already writes FlyDSL and v4 unlearned it; excludes flydsl/kernels/ wholesale because that library is the corpus the arena draws its FlyDSL tasks from, and the value here is the language rather than the operations

stage 2c of the v5 build: three recoveries needing no GPU and no new generation -- the chosen side of DPO pairs we are not training on, filtered for real per-row correctness rather than the corpus-level verified flag; an orphaned modality slice never wired into a mixture; and replay rows present in an older mixture and missing from v4

stage 3 of the v5 build: recover the generation signal SFT never read -- ranked groups, which build_sft silently drops, reframed as optimization demonstrations gated on a real gain over the sibling; and agentic trajectories, cut into correctness-preserving high-gain revision steps so training teaches a local improver rather than imitation of a whole search

stage 4 of the v5 build: assemble the mixture and its receipt, weighted by what the arena measurably pays for. v4 lost precisely where the question shape was missing, so this buys shapes rather than more kernels, upsamples FlyDSL and reports the residual gap rather than hiding it, and holds replay inside the 30-50% band that prevents catastrophic forgetting

stage 5: prove a built v5 file is clean and trainable before a GPU is spent on it, one gate per way the dataset could be wrong invisibly -- held-out leakage matched on the base id rather than the twin-suffixed one, arena contamination, provenance shape, a single assistant turn, torch-delegating reward hacks, over-cap and truncated targets, bad roles, empty content and duplication

run v5_verify_all.sh on a CPU compute node, because tokenizing ~206k rows on the login node's one core against NFS takes 10-15 minutes per pass and blocks the session; requests no GPU so it cannot queue behind real training

full pre-launch data verification: the shipped release parts must reproduce both halves of the mixture byte-for-byte, train and eval must be disjoint by message hash including upsampled duplicates, and BOTH halves must clear the v5_verify.py gates -- a bad eval row corrupts the retention signal as surely as a bad training row corrupts the weights
